regions.label: <rug 1>
regions.prompt: Large rectangular area rug with a low-pile, distressed texture in mottled shades of charcoal, slate gray, and taupe. The pattern is abstract and weathered, with darker patches concentrated on the image-left and lighter, sandy-beige tones appearing toward the center and image-right. It sits on a light-colored wood floor.

regions.label: <table 1>
regions.prompt: Rectangular coffee table with a thick, dark gray stone-textured top set into a thin, matte black metal frame. The frame consists of slender square-profile legs connected by a matching rectangular base that sits on a gray textured rug.

regions.label: <bowl 1>
regions.prompt: A small, dark charcoal-colored decorative bowl with a matte, slightly textured surface. It has a simple, rounded silhouette with a wide, open top and a narrow base, sitting on a dark grey surface.

regions.label: <vase 1>
regions.prompt: Small, light-gray ceramic vase with a matte, slightly textured surface. It has a globular body that tapers upward to a narrow neck and sits on a dark gray surface. Green leafy stems emerge from the top opening.

regions.label: <plant 1>
regions.prompt: Small, bushy green plant with numerous thin, branching stems and tiny, rounded leaves. The foliage is dense and spreads outward in a rounded, slightly irregular shape, with several longer stems extending upward and toward the image-right. The plant is set in a light-colored, off-white ceramic pot.

regions.label: <book 1>
regions.prompt: A thick, light-gray hardcover book lies flat on a dark surface. The cover features a rectangular grayscale photograph of a landscape or architectural scene on its right side. Small, illegible dark text is printed in the upper-left corner of the cover. The book's spine, visible on the image-left, is a matching light gray. The white edges of the interior pages are visible along the front and side.

regions.label: <sofa 1>
regions.prompt: L-shaped sectional sofa in light gray woven fabric. The left section is a chaise lounge, while the right section extends towards the foreground with a square armrest. Several matching square throw pillows in varying shades of gray are arranged along the backrest. A dark charcoal gray, chunky knit throw blanket is draped over the right armrest and seat.

regions.label: <pillow 1>
regions.prompt: A square, medium-gray throw pillow with a soft, matte fabric texture. It leans against a light gray sofa back, showing a slight indentation at the top center and soft creases along its bottom edge where it meets the seat. The lighting creates a gentle gradient, with the image-left side appearing slightly darker than the image-right.

regions.label: <pillow 2>
regions.prompt: A square, light grey fabric throw pillow with a soft, matte texture. It is propped upright and angled slightly toward the image-left, resting against the backrest of a matching light grey sofa. Subtle shadows define its plump, cushioned form.

regions.label: <pillow 3>
regions.prompt: Rectangular throw pillow in a medium-grey textured fabric, featuring a prominent V-shaped "karate chop" indentation along its top edge. It leans against a light-grey sofa backrest, with its bottom edge partially obscured by a dark, chunky-knit charcoal throw blanket.

regions.label: <pillow 4>
regions.prompt: A square, dark charcoal-grey throw pillow with a matte, finely textured fabric surface. It is positioned behind a lighter grey pillow on the image-left and rests against the light grey backrest of a sofa. The pillow's top-right corner is visible, showing a slightly rounded point.

regions.label: <blanket 1>
regions.prompt: Dark charcoal grey, chunky-knit throw blanket draped over the arm and seat of a light grey upholstered sofa. The blanket has a thick, nubby texture with visible vertical cable-knit patterns and frayed tassel edges at the bottom. One portion hangs down the front of the square sofa arm, while another section is bunched on the seat cushion to the image-left.

regions.label: <lamp 1>
regions.prompt: A floor lamp featuring a large, off-white cylindrical fabric drum shade. A thin, dark brown or black metal pole extends vertically from the center of the shade's base. The shade is illuminated from within, creating a warm, soft glow that is brightest at the bottom opening. A small dark finial is visible at the very top center of the shade.

regions.label: <painting 1>
regions.prompt: Large rectangular abstract painting in a thin black frame, viewed from a slight angle. The composition features a horizontal division: the upper three-quarters consist of textured, light gray and off-white tones with subtle vertical and horizontal brushstrokes, while the bottom quarter is a solid, dark charcoal black band with an irregular, painterly top edge that bleeds slightly into the lighter section above.

regions.label: <television 1>
regions.prompt: Large, wall-mounted flat-screen television with a slim black bezel and a matte black screen. It is angled toward the image-right. A tiny, silver sans-serif logo <text>SAMSUNG</text> is centered on the bottom bezel. The left side of the TV casing is visible, showing a thin profile with a small rectangular port or sensor near the bottom corner. The unit is mounted against a plain, off-white wall.

regions.label: <cabinet 1>
regions.prompt: Long, low-profile media console made of light-toned wood with a visible grain. The unit features five handleless cabinet doors along its front face, separated by thin vertical seams. It sits on a recessed plinth base of the same wood material. On its flat top surface, a long, black rectangular soundbar is positioned towards the image-left. The console is angled from the image-left foreground towards the image-right background against a white wall and light wood flooring.

regions.label: <speaker 1>
regions.prompt: A long, sleek, black rectangular soundbar with a matte finish sits horizontally on a light wood surface. The front and top surfaces are covered in a fine dark mesh grille, while the left end cap is a solid, smooth black panel. It is positioned against a plain, off-white wall.

regions.label: <vase 2>
regions.prompt: Small, dark charcoal-grey ceramic vase with a matte, slightly textured surface. It has a stout, cylindrical body with rounded shoulders that taper into a short, wide neck and a flat circular rim. Green leafy stems emerge from the top opening.

regions.label: <plant 2>
regions.prompt: A small, bushy plant with numerous thin, branching stems and small, oval-shaped dark green leaves. The foliage forms a dense, rounded cluster, with several individual sprigs extending upward and outward against a plain, off-white background. The leaves have a slightly matte texture and are arranged alternately along the stems.

regions.label: <painting 2>
regions.prompt: Right-side vertical edge and corners of a thin black picture frame. A wide, flat white mat board surrounds a grayscale artwork, of which only a narrow vertical sliver is visible on the image-left, showing mottled dark and light gray tones.

regions.label: <window 1>
regions.prompt: Large three-pane window with a thin black frame, divided into three vertical rectangular sections by two slim black mullions. Through the glass, a bright outdoor scene features a large tree trunk on the image-left and dense green foliage across the middle and lower sections. In the background, a white house with a dark gabled roof is partially visible behind the trees.

regions.label: <tree 1>
regions.prompt: A tall deciduous tree with a thick, textured grey-brown trunk on the image-left, partially obscured by the black vertical frame of a window. Its canopy of dense, light-green leaves fills much of the upper and middle portions of the view, blending with other lush green foliage and shrubs in the background. A dark roofline of a house is visible through the leaves in the upper-right section.

regions.label: <tree 2>
regions.prompt: A thick, light-grey tree trunk with textured bark stands on the image-left, extending vertically through the frame. A large branch forks from the upper trunk, reaching toward the top-right. The background is filled with dense, lush green foliage in varying shades of lime and emerald, with soft-focus leaves creating a layered, garden-like appearance.

regions.label: <house 1>
regions.prompt: A distant house with a dark charcoal gabled roof and light-colored siding, partially obscured by lush green deciduous trees and shrubs. A thick, vertical black window mullion divides the view. To the image-right of the mullion, a white architectural detail, possibly a window frame or pillar, is visible through the dense foliage.

regions.label: <walls 1>
regions.prompt: Smooth, off-white interior walls define the room's perimeter. The image-left wall features a mounted black flat-screen television above a light wood console. The central wall is dominated by a large, black-framed three-pane window looking out onto green foliage. To the image-right, the wall continues behind a floor lamp and a large, vertically oriented abstract painting in a black frame, featuring a textured white upper half and a solid black lower half. A thin white baseboard runs along the bottom of the walls where they meet the light wood flooring. The ceiling is the same off-white color, with two small, recessed circular lights visible.

regions.label: <ceiling 1>
regions.prompt: Flat, off-white ceiling surface with a smooth, matte finish. Two small, circular recessed lights are embedded in the surface, spaced evenly apart across the horizontal span. Subtle, soft shadows create a slight gradient, with the corners appearing darker than the central area.

regions.label: <floor 1>
regions.prompt: Light-colored wood plank flooring runs horizontally across the room. A large, rectangular area rug with a distressed, mottled texture in shades of grey, charcoal, and beige sits in the center. Atop the rug is a rectangular coffee table with a thick, dark grey stone or concrete top and a minimalist black metal frame base. On the table's surface are a dark grey bowl, a small white vase with green sprigs, and a thin book. To the image-left, the bottom portion of a light wood media console is visible. To the image-right, the lower section of a light grey fabric sectional sofa rests on the rug, with a dark charcoal grey knit throw blanket draped over its arm.

layout.prompt:
This is a photo of a modern, minimalist living room. The aesthetic is clean and contemporary, with a neutral color palette of white, light wood, gray, and black. The room is brightly lit with even, soft light.

In the foreground, a gray, low-pile rectangular rug <rug 1> sits on a light-colored wood floor. Centered on <rug 1> is a low, rectangular coffee table <table 1> with a dark gray stone top and a black metal frame. On <table 1>, there is a small black bowl <bowl 1>, a small white ceramic vase <vase 1> containing a leafy green plant <plant 1>, and a thin book <book 1>.

To the image-right, a large L-shaped sectional sofa <sofa 1> upholstered in light gray fabric faces the image-left. Several matching gray throw pillows <pillow 1>, <pillow 2>, <pillow 3>, and <pillow 4> are arranged on <sofa 1>. A dark gray, chunky knit throw blanket <blanket 1> is draped over the right armrest of <sofa 1>. Behind the right end of <sofa 1>, a floor lamp <lamp 1> with a thin black stand and a cylindrical white shade stands in the corner. On the wall behind <lamp 1>, a large vertical rectangular painting <painting 1> is hung. <Painting 1> features a minimalist abstract design with a large off-white upper section and a thick black horizontal band across the bottom.

On the image-left wall, a large flat-screen television <television 1> with a black frame is mounted above a long, low wooden media console <cabinet 1>. <Cabinet 1> is made of light-toned wood and has several doors. On top of <cabinet 1>, a black soundbar <speaker 1> sits directly below <television 1>. To the right of <speaker 1>, a small dark gray vase <vase 2> holds a leafy green plant <plant 2>. To the left of <television 1>, a small portion of another framed artwork <painting 2> is visible on the wall.

In the center background, a large three-paneled window <window 1> with a black frame looks out onto a lush green landscape of trees <tree 1> and <tree 2>. The foliage is dense and green, and a portion of a white house <house 1> is visible through the branches. The walls of the room are a flat, clean white, and the ceiling has two small recessed lights <light 1> and <light 2>.
